### [Characteristic-Space Metrics in Factor Models: Identification and Inference](/research/characteristic-space-metrics.html)

Factor models can fit returns identically yet split them differently among latent factors, observed factors and an intercept; an inner product on characteristic space selects the split.

::: {.paper-links}
[Paper page](/research/characteristic-space-metrics.html) · [PDF](/assets/pdfs/Characteristic_Space_Metrics_Main.pdf) · [SSRN: 10.2139/ssrn.7445120](https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7445120)
:::
:::

::: {.paper-row}

[Working paper]{.tag}

SSRN preprint · March 2026
:::

::: {.body}
### [A Geometric Framework for Identification in Characteristic-Based Factor Models](/research/geometric-framework.html)

Identification depends on the metric that decides which directions in characteristic space are economically distinct, and the long-run cross-section of firm characteristics supplies that metric.

Earlier, broader version; the identification and inference results continue in [Characteristic-Space Metrics](/research/characteristic-space-metrics.html) (above).

::: {.paper-links}
[Paper page](/research/geometric-framework.html) · [PDF](/assets/pdfs/Geometric_Framework_SSRN_7013178.pdf) · [SSRN: 10.2139/ssrn.7013178](https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7013178)
:::

### [Characteristic Geometry and Portfolio Choice](/research/characteristic-geometry.html)

Nearly identical forecasts generate different portfolios because a fixed adjustment to factor variances imposes different exposure penalties across measurement conventions.

::: {.paper-links}
[Paper page](/research/characteristic-geometry.html) · [Slides (PDF)](/assets/pdfs/Characteristic_Geometry_and_Portfolio_Choice_Slides.pdf)
:::
:::

[Working paper]{.tag}

September 2026

::: {.body}
### [Interpreting Estimated Pricing Errors: Evidence from Characteristic-Based Return Forecasts](/research/interpreting-pricing-errors.html)

When one model reports smaller estimated pricing errors, the paper separates changes in fitted expected returns from changes in factor loading spaces, and finds that a large gap mainly reflects different estimated means.

::: {.paper-links}
[Paper page](/research/interpreting-pricing-errors.html) · [PDF](/assets/pdfs/Interpreting_Estimated_Pricing_Errors.pdf)
